search_string_human_readable: title or abstract contains 'cocoa' AND 'yield' AND 'biodiversity'

filters_applied.rationale: Tightest scoping that returns a tractable corpus. Broader search ('cocoa OR cacao' AND 'biodiversity OR shade OR agroforestry' AND 'yield') returned 18,761; this filter narrows to papers that explicitly cover all three concepts in title or abstract.
Restrict to open access so PDF download is feasible without paywall access.
English-only declared in framing doc. Acknowledged limitation.
Last 15 years captures the modern agroforestry-resurgence literature; older work would dilute with pre-yield-modelling-era studies.

notes: Title hits include Cocoa agroforestry vs monocultures meta-analysis (Niether 2020), Shade Tree Diversity / Cocoa Pest Damage / Yield (Gras 2013), Structural characteristics determine productivity (2017), Conservation through Chocolate (Waldron 2012). Mix of empirical and meta-analytic — good corpus for a synthesis demo. Not all 48 will have downloadable PDFs.
